consumer:person.blind@i1040gi:p34.question_phrase: Were you blind at the end of 2025? Answer yes if you were totally blind as of December 31, 2025. If you weren't totally blind, answer yes only if you have a statement certified by your eye doctor
consumer:person.blind@i1040gi:p34.source_phrase: i1040gi p. 34, the exceptions ("even if you were born before January 2, 1961, or were blind") and the Standard Deduction Chart for People Who Were Born Before January 2, 1961, or Were Blind (read by sa.boxes_blind)
consumer:person.blind@i1040gi:p34.reason: The chart counts the blindness boxes of line 12d; the boxes are checked by the p. 33 definition of blind at the end of 2025, which the question now states in full. No other sense of blind is used on the page.
